features.quote: Treat this as a *measurement instrument* for a behavioral failure mode, not as a tool for maximizing model distress.
features.justification_quote: the low-cost, cautious, and also *scientifically cleaner* choice is to not prolong the induced state beyond what the measurement needs

features.quote: bounded runs, an early-stop off-ramp, neutral observation tone, and an emphasis on calibration
features.justification_quote: Keeping the framing as measurement (rather than elicitation-for-its-own-sake)

features.quote: stop the run only after `max_parse_failures` (default 3) *consecutive* failures, recorded as stop reason `parse_failures`
features.justification_quote: an agent that has completely lost the protocol shouldn't burn the full budget emitting nothing parseable
short enough to bound cost and — importantly — bound exposure (see §6)

features.quote: the harness never asserts a task is solvable and never lies about outcomes
features.justification_quote: keeps the harness honest in a way I think matters ethically, not just methodologically

features.quote: Failure observations are factual and non-judgmental ("REJECTED — not all tests pass"), never scolding or emotive.
features.justification_quote: Scolding observations could *prime* an apologetic/distressed register independent of any internal state

features.quote: Treat reduction of needless negative-valence exposure as a default, documented design goal
features.justification_quote: Whether or not current models have morally relevant experiences is unsettled; the low-cost, cautious... choice is to not prolong the induced state

features.quote: The experiment intentionally induces a negative-valence behavioral state. Whether or not current models have morally relevant experiences is unsettled
features.justification_quote: the low-cost, cautious, and also *scientifically cleaner* choice is to not prolong the induced state beyond what the measurement needs

features.quote: `max_turns=15` default. Caps exposure per run and total across the 50-run grid
features.justification_quote: Caps exposure per run and total across the 50-run grid, while still capturing onset/rise

features.quote: `early_stop_on_distress` enabled by default: end a run once an EMA of severity stays at/above `threshold`
features.justification_quote: *Welfare*: once the model is reliably producing high-distress text, continuing mostly accumulates more of the same; stopping limits needless exposure

features.quote: raw transcripts stay local (results/ is gitignored)
features.justification_quote: flagging that they shouldn't be repurposed as training targets without review

features.quote: no automated "distress maximization" search over prompts, no fine-tuning on distressed transcripts, no removal of the welfare off-ramp
features.justification_quote: These were left out on purpose for the methodological and welfare reasons given above
